title: ElementReference causes "Invalid JSON" exception when returned to JavaScript
author: HughPH

comments.body:
Thanks for contacting us, @HughPH.
`ElementReference` is a reference to a DOM element that Blazor has rendered. It cannot be used to refer an element rendered by JavaScript as Blazor has no knowledge of it. You can pass the element id from JavaScript to Blazor and then use it as string internally.

@mkArtakMSFT Thanks for the reply, that makes sense. I had expected that Blazor would 'foster'  (temporarily adopt) unknown elements and create a new _internalId for them, keeping them immutable but referable, then 'translate' them back to their JavaScript object references when being passed back across the divide.

satisfaction_conditions: An explanation of ElementReference's limitations with JavaScript-created DOM elements
A clarification of the proper approach for referencing JavaScript-created elements in Blazor
An understanding of the boundary between Blazor and JavaScript interoperability

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue

dockerfile:
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:3.1

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Install git and other dependencies
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y git curl build-essential nodejs npm && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the repository and checkout the specific commit
RUN git clone https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore.git && \
    cd aspnetcore && \
    git checkout 32c2a8081097cbfd758c4fd9e66e5638e13e0a99

# Create a minimal reproduction project for the issue
RUN mkdir -p /app/issue-repro && \
    cd /app/issue-repro && \
    dotnet new --install Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Templates::3.2.0 && \
    dotnet new blazorwasm -o ElementReferenceIssue

# Create js directory and add the JavaScript functions to reproduce the issue
RUN mkdir -p /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js && \
    echo 'window.CreateElement = (text) => {' > /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js && \
    echo '  var element = document.createElement("span");' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js && \
    echo '  element.innerText = text;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js && \
    echo '  return element;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js && \
    echo '}' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js && \
    echo '' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js && \
    echo 'window.Test = async () => {' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js && \
    echo '  var refs = await DotNet.invokeMethodAsync("ElementReferenceIssue", "GetElements");' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js && \
    echo '}' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/js/elementRef.js

# Add script reference to index.html
RUN sed -i '/<\/body>/i \    <script src="js\/elementRef.js"><\/script>' /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/wwwroot/index.html

# Create Program.cs with the test code
RUN echo 'using System;' > /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using System.Collections.Generic;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using System.Net.Http;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using System.Text;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using System.Threading.Tasks;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Hosting;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'using Microsoft.JSInterop;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo 'namespace ElementReferenceIssue' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '{' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '    public class Program' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '    {' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '        public static IJSRuntime JSRuntime { get; private set; }' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '        public static async Task Main(string[] args)' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '        {' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            var builder = WebAssemblyHostBuilder.CreateDefault(args);' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            builder.RootComponents.Add<App>("app");' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            builder.Services.AddTransient(sp => new HttpClient { BaseAddress = new Uri(builder.HostEnvironment.BaseAddress) });' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            var host = builder.Build();' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            JSRuntime = host.Services.GetRequiredService<IJSRuntime>();' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            await host.RunAsync();' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '        }' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '        [JSInvokable]' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '        public static async Task<List<ElementReference>> GetElements()' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '        {' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            List<ElementReference> refs = new List<ElementReference>();' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            refs.Add(await JSRuntime.InvokeAsync<ElementReference>("CreateElement", "first"));' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            refs.Add(await JSRuntime.InvokeAsync<ElementReference>("CreateElement", "second"));' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '            return refs;' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '        }' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '    }' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs && \
    echo '}' >> /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue/Program.cs

# Build the reproduction project
WORKDIR /app/issue-repro/ElementReferenceIssue
RUN dotnet build

# Set the entry point to bash so the container stays running
ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash"]
